name: Maldives

flag.description: A red field with a green rectangle in the centre containing a white crescent whose horns face the fly.
flag.symbolism: Red represents the blood of the nation's heroes, green peace and prosperity (and the coconut palm), and the white crescent Islam.

hook: The Maldives is a green island-shaped rectangle with a white crescent, floating in a red sea.
trivia: Early Maldivian flags were plain red; the green panel and crescent were added in the 20th century.
The Maldives is the lowest-lying country in the world, with an average ground level of about 1.5 metres above sea level.
